# Getting started

Run this project locally, in order.

## 1. Clone the repository

```bash
git clone https://github.com/seanchatmangpt/cgap && cd cgap
```

## 2. Add the umbrella crate to a consumer project

```bash
cargo add cgap@26.11.1
```

## 3. Build the workspace

```bash
cargo build --workspace
```
